{{Quote|We'll deny the Trade Federation shipping rights on Kinyen and along the Trade Spine.|Pax Teem to Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Kinyen''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], located on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] at the junction to the [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]]. It was the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> with a recorded history dating back to [[10,000 BBY]]. Though it was an outpost of the violent [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]], during its recorded history, the planet has had no local wars. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Kharrus/Legends|Kharrus]] represented Kinyen in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Description==
Located in the [[Kinyen system/Legends|Kinyen system]] of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] and [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Bes Ber Bikade sector/Legends|Bes Ber Bikade sector]], Kinyen was a terrestrial [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]], or [[Farm/Legends|farming]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The planet's orbital period was 256 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]], and each day lasted 28 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]]. Kinyen was the homeworld of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and it lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] and [[Great Gran Run/Legends|Great Gran Run]]. The terrain of the planet featured multiple biomes, including fields, [[Forest/Legends|forests]], and [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. As agriworld, Kinyen exported [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] such as [[silvergrass]] and tubers, while importing technology. Silvergrass was a [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] that formed the basis of the Gran diet and was widely cultivated on the planet.<ref name="SoR" />

Multiple creatures lived on Kinyen. These included the [[gamwidge]], which was herded by ranchers; the houjix, which was the most popular companion animal on the planet; the [[Tayan falcon]], a [[Bird/Legends|bird]] of prey that was sacred to the [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] [[religion]]; the [[llaya]], which preyed on gamwidges; and rodents and insects, both of which were [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by the Tayan falcon, but otherwise would have targeted crops.<ref name="SoR" />

==History==
===Early history===
The Gran evolved from [[Diet/Legends|herbivorous]], mountain-dwelling creatures, who began to band together as protection from predators. 15,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Kinyen's Gran began to trade with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Despite this trade, Kinyen remained closed to outsiders except for a single walled-off region of the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. During the [[Fifteenth Pius Dea Crusade]]<ref name="SoR" /> in [[11,591 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare" /> Kinyen resisted the forces of Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Contispex XI|Contispex the XI]]. Veterans of the war who followed the [[Doellinism/Legends|Doellinist]] [[religion]] eventually came together as the [[Tayan League]], an organization originally designed to resist the crusade. After the heroic veterans were pressured to take political office, the Tayan League became a [[Socialism|socialist]] [[Politics/Legends|political]] party whose influence eventually converted nearly all Gran to Doellinism. For ten thousand years, the Tayan League led the planet through an era of peace and prosperity, until progressives known as [[Neo-Tayan]]s arose within the party.<ref name="SoR" />

Around [[1500 BBY]],<ref name="1500date">According to ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', the Neo-Tayans established the offworld quarters and [[Gran colonization program]] 1500 years before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]</ref> the Neo-Tayans created new offworld quarters&mdash;districts of cities in which foreigners were permitted to live&mdash;and established a [[Gran colonization program|colonization program]], which began to settle other worlds such as [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and [[Hok/Legends|Hok]]. These colonies brought enormous power, prestige, and wealth to Kinyen. The Gran also rose to prominence within the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a wealthy interstellar trading conglomerate. Although Kinyen had long been a waypoint for travelers moving [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] along the Corellian Trade Spine, the planet's new influence within the Trade Federation allowed the Gran to create the Great Gran Run, a new hyperlane that made Kinyen a hub for traffic from many worlds beyond the Western Reaches. This in turn brought enormous wealth to the world.<ref name="SoR" />

Ultimately, however, violence on the colony worlds, especially a [[Dug-Gran conflict|conflict]] with Malastare's native [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]], eroded the Gran's initial compassionate reputation. The Republic was forced to intervene in the conflict on Malastare, and though Kinyen used its wealth as leverage in the conflict mediation, the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] species took control of the Trade Federation. Afterwards, the Kinyen Gran cut off the residents of their colonies and became isolationist. The colonies formed the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]], a new government to replace the one on Kinyen. On Kinyen itself, the colonies were referred to as the "lost children of Kinyen." Though many Gran mourned the loss of their colonies through the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], all the Gran living on them were effectively exiled from Kinyen.<ref name="SoR" /> By [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]],<ref name="67Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] to [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]].</ref> the Protectorate had overshadowed Kinyen itself. In that year, the Protectorate's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], [[Pax Teem]], threatened to prevent the Trade Federation from being able to trade on Kinyen in an attempt to indicate the Protectorate's power to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|That this tragedy should occur so deep within our borders points to the irrevocable damage already sustained by the Republic. It is not only a tragic loss to Malastare and Kinyen, but also a dire warning to the Supreme Chancellor.|Ask Aak|<ref name="HNN50">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|50|news/1344_1.html|Senator Moe Killed in Blast}}</ref>}}
On the date 13:3:14 under the [[Great ReSynchronization]], Kinyen's [[Team Kinyen|limmie team]] participated in the [[Galactic Cup of Limmie|Galactic Cup]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and was defeated 2-0 by [[Yag'Dhul/Legends|Yag'Dhul's]] [[Team Yag'Dhul|team]].<ref name="HNN47">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|sports/13314_1.html|Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round}}</ref> Later, on 13:4:4, an explosion killed Senator [[Aks Moe/Legends|Aks Moe]] of Malastare. In a statement, acting representative [[Ask Aak/Legends|Ask Aak]] described his death as a tragic event for both Malastare and Kinyen.<ref name="HNN50" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates {{TCW|The Gungan General}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Republic, Kinyen's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], [[Kharrus]], was killed by [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirates]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Due to the planet's ties to the Separatists through the Trade Federation, the Dugs prevented a new Senator from being appointed. This isolation, combined with mounting pressure from the the Confederacy, led to Kinyen becoming a staging ground for Separatist attacks along the Corellian Trade Spine.<ref name="SoR" />

====Imperial conquest and rule====
Kinyen surrendered without a fight to the Galactic Empire after the Clone Wars. The terms of surrender allowed the Imperials to send [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] to Kinyen's offworld quarters but not to land occupation forces on the planet itself. It could also use the planet as a staging area during its [[Western Reaches Operation|Western Reaches Campaign]]<ref name="SoR" /> in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]].<ref name="16date">The [[Declaration of a New Order]] is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. The [[Western Reaches Operation]] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the Declaration of a New Order by ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', meaning that it must have occurred in [[16 BBY/Legends|16 BBY]].</ref> Meanwhile, Kinyen was allowed to continue its trade practices. The Empire initially upheld its side of the bargain, but eventually demanded an increase in food production and more access to the planet. The Gran refused. In response, the Empire landed occupation forces on the planet and [[Massacre at Malthee|bombarded]] the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Malthee]], destroying it. The protests that occurred on the planet afterward were crushed, and most of the Gran populace decided to patiently wait for the Empire to implode.<ref name="SoR" />

==Inhabitants==
===The Gran===
[[File:Gran_by_Balanescu.png|thumb|left|200px|The Gran were the native sentient species of Kinyen.]]

1,983,000,000 individuals lived on Kinyen, of whom 96% were members of its [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] Gran species. Their primary languages were [[Gran (language)/Legends|Gran]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]]. The Gran who lived on Kinyen followed a strict moral code that was not shared by Gran living on other worlds. Community and cooperation were the basis of Gran society, which made all of the planet's cities, no matter how large, retain the feel of a small town. Communication was important to the Gran, and their society was based around socialization. Festivals, galas, and other celebrations were observed across the planet, restaurants seated guests at communal tables, employers set aside time each day for social breaks, and most of the planet's transports were [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-piloted, allowing passengers to talk to one another more. The game [[Limmie/Legends|bolo-ball]] was one of the few areas in which off-world culture infiltrated Kinyen's. The planet's [[Team Kinyen|team]] was intensely popular, and the massive [[Grand Khanum Stadium]] could seat 150,000 spectators.<ref name="SoR" />

Most Gran were followers of Doellinism, a religion based around the goddess [[Doellin]], [[Gender/Legends|her]] avatar [[Taya]], and her enemy [[Byllaya]]. The Gran were seen as Doellin's crop, which Byllaya constantly sought to consume. Although by the Imperial Period the stories of Doellin and Byllaya were generally viewed as metaphorical rather than literal, they were still influential on Gran life. Violence was anathema to Doellinist belief, meaning that minor acts of aggression were treated as seriously on Kinyen as murder was on other worlds. Similarly, strong restrictions were placed on addictive substances such as [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]], violations of which bore heavy penalties such as [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] or a [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]].<ref name="SoR" />

After the Galactic Empire occupied Kinyen, a number of its residents joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Others, however, were content to wait patiently and peacefully for what they assumed was an inevitable implosion of the Empire. Even those that did join the Alliance were generally unwilling to commit acts of violence, and generally took support roles. [[Gorbek Fask]] was a resistance leader on Kinyen who funneled food and [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to the Alliance, although actual Alliance operations on the planet were banned by the government out of fear of another bombardment.<ref name="SoR" />

===Government and politics===
Kinyen's government was a [[Socialism|socialist]] [[demarchy]] led by the [[Tayan League]], a [[Politics/Legends|political]] party. The planet's socialist government evolved as a result of the natural need of all Gran to congregate with one another. Long before the Imperial Period, all loner tendencies were eliminated from the Gran populace, allowing the socialist system to remain stable to an extent that confused political theorists. Most industries on Kinyen, such as food production and construction, were privatized. A few parts of the economy were semi-privatized, such as the shipping industry. The company [[Saeduree River Shipping]] had a privileged status within the government and had exclusive shipping rights for most of the [[Capra's continent|continent]] on which it operated.<ref name="SoR" />

Kinyen's government included two legislative bodies&mdash;the [[Field House]] and [[Hearth House]]&mdash;which met in [[Doellin's Ring]], a structure that served as the center of Kinyen's government. The Field House was composed of randomly selected Gran with a limited education in politics. Its members served for one year each and had veto power over the Hearth House, which was responsible for creating most new laws and whose members were more extensively educated in political matters and served for life after being selected from a pool of candidates by the Field House. This arrangement helped ensure that the working class had a say in Kinyen's politics.<ref name="SoR" />

All Gran [[Youngling/Legends|children]] on Kinyen were placed in specialized education programs based on test results and needed jobs around the world. Because of this, Kinyen's unemployment rate was lower and gross domestic product higher than most other planets in the region. The only way a Gran could choose a job other than the one selected for them by the government was to join the [[Doellinist priesthood]]. An estimated one in ten Gran had some affiliation with the priesthood. Some priests bore the title of [[Doellinist High Priest|High Priest]]; these individuals carried [[Tayan staff]]s.<ref name="SoR" />

==Locations==
Hundreds of cities were located on Kinyen, each of which was an architectural achievement. Cities on the planet included [[Capra]] and the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Aygion Mountain]]. The latter was located on a [[Aygion Mountain (mountain)|mountain]] of the same name, which was itself a part of the [[Pansat Mountain Range]]. Aygion Mountain had a population of 100 million and was located in the place held to be the ancestral homeland of the Gran. The city contained the [[First Temple of Doellin]]&mdash;the largest Doellinist temple in the world&mdash;as well as Doellin's Ring, an oval structure that served as the center of Kinyen's government.<ref name="SoR" />

Capra was located along the [[Saeduree River]]. The city had tens of millions of residents and was originally founded as an intercontinental shipping hub. The city contained many tall spires, including the [[Saeduree River Shipping Tower|SRS Tower]], headquarters of the [[Saeduree River Shipping]] company, which had been founded thousands of years prior to the Imperial Period. The city's spires were designed to capture the sense of flowing water, and as such were primarily [[Color/Legends|colored]] in shades of blue and green, with umber and ultraviolet accents. Even the largest buildings contained few large atria, as the Gran preferred smaller spaces that promoted increased socialization. Capra was also home to a [[Capra Spaceport|spaceport]] and [[Chorba Chuggers]], a [[Cantina/Legends|speakeasy]] that was one of the few places on the planet one could acquire alcohol.<ref name="SoR" />

Malthee was another city on Kinyen. It was home to tens of millions of people, but during the Imperial Period it was bombarded and destroyed by the Galactic Empire, forming the [[Malthee Crater]]. In the aftermath, the Gran organized multiple [[Standard week/Legends|week]]-long pilgrimages to the ruins, where they told stories of the dead and examined the names of those the Empire had killed, which had since been carved into rock. The [[Malthee Temple]], a Doellinist cathedral, was also constructed in the ruins.<ref name="SoR" />

Thousands of [[farming cluster]]s were spread across Kinyen's surface. The [[Ayanee Farming Cluster]] was a typical farming cluster. It was a hexagonal region divided into six triangular farms. The residents of the cluster farmed silvergrass together with the goal of meeting government farming quotas. In addition to the six families of the cluster, each of whom lived in its own house, farm employees also lived and work in the cluster, and a few stores stood between the homes. During the Imperial Period, [[Tayala Lees]] led the cluster. Under instructions from Kinyen's government, she diverted ten percent of her crop to the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kinyen was first mentioned in [[West End Games]]' [[1990]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''.<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> It made its first full appearance in the [[1998]] [[LucasArts]] video game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>

[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Kinyen in the Farfin sector (a misspelling of the [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]]) of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="Rebellion" />
